guidance.zh-CN: 管理包含写和读，写包含读。现有数据范围、字段策略和发布门禁继续生效。
guidance.en: Manage includes Write and Read; Write includes Read. Existing record scopes, field policies and release gates still apply.

legacy.zh-CN: 存在历史零散授权，尚未归入完整级别。选择级别后请预览差异，保存前授权保持不变。
legacy.en: Legacy grants do not form a complete level. Select a level and review the differences; access remains unchanged until saved.
